question.instructions: Does handling `latest_user_message` (in the context of `previous_turns` and the other state) require the {domain} tools?
question.false: Not needed: small talk, general knowledge, a quick web lookup, memory, or a different capability.

alwaysAvailable: Web search, reading web pages, memory, conversation-history search and skill reading are always available and are not part of these groups.

gmail.description: Search or read the user's Gmail (two connected accounts).
gmail.examples: did X reply, anything from my bank, find the invoice, what did the landlord say, summarise unread

calendar.description: Read the user's Google Calendar or draft a new event.
calendar.examples: am I free Thursday, what's on at 3pm, when is my meeting, add dentist on the 12th

daily.description: The user's to-do items, notes, timed reminders and daily reminder/briefing schedules.
daily.examples: remind me at 7pm, add milk to my list, what's open on my list, morning briefing

jobs.description: Saved job roles and applications, role-fit analysis, interview preparation and the prep Sheet.
jobs.examples: how well does the Stripe role fit, mark application rejected, prep me for the interview

work.description: Start, continue, check, pause or cancel a long-running multi-step background task.
work.examples: keep going on that task, cancel the background job, do this in the background step by step

research.description: Delegate an in-depth multi-source research report with citations (not a quick fact).
research.examples: deep dive on X with sources, thorough sourced comparison

media.description: Look at an attached image or read an attached or earlier PDF/document.
media.examples: [Attached image ...], summarise this PDF, what does clause 7 of the contract say

canvas.description: Create, update, read or list saved canvases (documents the user opens in the Mini App).
canvas.examples: save this as a canvas, update my trip canvas, show my saved docs

subscriptions.description: Saved recurring payments, subscriptions, memberships, bills, trial ends, cancellation deadlines and linked reminders.
subscriptions.examples: track Netflix at 22.98 SGD monthly, what am I paying for, remind me before my gym renewal, I cancelled Adobe

parcels.description: Track or update parcels, packages or online orders the user awaits.
parcels.examples: where's my Amazon package, did the DHL thing arrive, what am I still waiting on

library.description: Singapore library (NLB/Libby) ebook availability, borrowing, loans, holds, due dates.
library.examples: is Atomic Habits available, can I borrow X, what do I have on loan

watchlist.description: The user's stock watchlist and price-drop alerts (tickers, thresholds, pausing).
watchlist.examples: how is AAPL doing, alert me if NVDA drops 5%, stop watching Tesla

news.description: The user's daily news bulletin: following news sites or blogs, delivery time, topics, sending one now, and what their thumbs up/down taught.
news.examples: follow theverge.com, send my news at 8am, add AI as a topic, send me a bulletin now, stop following that blog

routines.description: Recurring automated agent routines that run on a schedule.
routines.examples: every Monday at 9 summarise my inbox, pause my weekly routine, what automations run

responsibilities.description: Create or manage an owner-confirmed ongoing concern that watches exact sources and only notifies on meaningful changes.
responsibilities.examples: keep an eye on these parcels until they arrive, when my landlord emails tell me that evening, monitor this until resolved, show monitoring history

skills.description: Version history, drafts, evaluation, activation or rollback of the assistant's text skills.
skills.examples: show the history of the interview skill, roll back the research skill

gathering.description: Gather invoice PDF files across exact providers/accounts/months, using selected email, supplied documents or authenticated browser portals; inspect collection progress and login handoffs.
gathering.examples: gather my September invoices, collect OpenAI Anthropic and DigitalOcean invoices, use the billing portal only, did that collection finish
